hero.description: YouCar is a reliable automotive marketplace in Uzbekistan. Here, ordinary users post advertisements for the sale of their cars, and buyers use convenient filters to find the right option.

steps.title: Register
steps.description: Create an account in a few minutes and log in to the platform.

steps.title: Post a Listing
steps.description: Upload car information and photos, specify the price.

steps.title: Find a Buyer
steps.description: Interested users will contact you directly and negotiate the deal.

features.title: Safe
features.description: Listings are posted only by registered users.

features.title: Fast
features.description: Your listing will appear on the site within a few minutes.

features.title: Convenient Search
features.description: Filters by brand, price, year of manufacture, and other parameters.

features.title: Direct Communication
features.description: Seller and buyer communicate without intermediaries.

cards.title: Turnkey Solution
cards.description: You can purchase a car directly from an official auto dealer with us, without intermediaries and translators.

cards.title: Online chat 24/7
cards.description: We are always available to answer your questions and help you with your choice.

cards.title: Simplified car selection
cards.description: We created this site to make the search for a car according to your criteria as simple and convenient as possible.

cards.title: Delivery
cards.description: Delivery to any region, direct contact without intermediaries

aboutSection.title: About Our Company
aboutSection.description: We have extensive experience working with the Korean car market and carefully select cars for our clients, taking into account their needs and budget. We work only with reliable suppliers and carriers to ensure safe and reliable delivery.

callCard.title: Can't decide?
callCard.subtitle: Leave a request, and our managers will help you!

benefits: We'll help you choose and negotiate
